answer_1.quote: ConceptFlow (Conversation generation with Concept Flow) ... leverages commonsense knowledge graphs to model the conversation flow ... Our experiments on a Reddit conversation dataset with a commonsense knowledge graph, ConceptNet, demonstrate the effectiveness of ConceptFlow.

answer_2.quote: A wide range of evaluation metrics are used to evaluate the quality of generated responses: PPL (Serban et al., 2016), Bleu , Nist , ROUGE and Meteor are used for relevance and repetitiveness; Dist-1, Dist-2 and Ent-4 are used for diversity.

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation. The human evaluation focuses on two aspects: appropriateness and informativeness. All responses of sampled 100 cases are selected from four methods ... The responses are scored from 1 to 4 by five judges.
answer_4.guideline: Judges score each response on a 1‑4 scale for appropriateness (on‑topic) and informativeness (provides new information).
